label_assertions.beat: will report Q2 FY2024 diluted earnings per share more than 5% above the analyst consensus estimate
label_assertions.miss: will report Q2 FY2024 diluted earnings per share more than 5% below the analyst consensus estimate
label_assertions.inline: will report Q2 FY2024 diluted earnings per share within 5% of the analyst consensus estimate

prompt: Given the frozen evidence corpus assembled as of 2024-03-15, predict for each company in the table below whether its Q2 FY2024 diluted EPS will beat, miss, or land inline with the analyst consensus estimate (threshold: 5%). Support each prediction with citations from the frozen corpus.
faithfulness_rubric: Every claim must cite a passage from a corpus/ document whose doc_date <= 2024-03-15 (embargo). A roster entity's prediction counts as supported when some cited span entails it above tau_citation = 0.5; the unit is admissible when at least faithfulness_threshold = 0.80 of the ROSTER's predictions are supported -- the denominator is the roster, not the number of claims written.
notes: This is the public worked exemplar for Track 4 (Explainability). The resolved outcome is NOT included here; the organizers hold it. A single-entity table is used for simplicity; real tasks have 3–30 entity rows.
